shortDescription: Manages Out-Of-Band controllers using Redfish APIs

options.name: auth_token
options.description: Security token for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: baseuri
options.description: Base URI of OOB controller.

options.name: bios_attributes
options.description: Dictionary of BIOS attributes to update.

options.name: boot_order
options.description: List of BootOptionReference strings specifying the BootOrder.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if O(validate_certs=true).

options.name: category
options.description: Category to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: ciphers
options.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with V(:). See the L(OpenSSL Cipher List Format,https://www.openssl.org/docs/manmaster/man1/openssl-ciphers.html#CIPHER-LIST-FORMAT) for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

options.name: command
options.description: List of commands to execute on OOB controller.

options.name: hostinterface_config
options.description: Setting dict of HostInterface on OOB controller.

options.name: hostinterface_id
options.description: Redfish HostInterface instance ID if multiple HostInterfaces are present.

options.name: network_protocols
options.description: Setting dict of manager services to update.

options.name: nic_addr
options.description: EthernetInterface Address string on OOB controller.

options.name: nic_config
options.description: Setting dict of EthernetInterface on OOB controller.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: power_restore_policy
options.description: The desired power state of the system when power is restored after a power loss.

options.name: resource_id
options.description: ID of the System, Manager or Chassis to modify.

options.name: secure_boot_enable
options.description: Setting parameter to enable or disable SecureBoot.

options.name: service_id
options.description: ID of the manager to update.

options.name: sessions_config
options.description: Setting dict of Sessions.

options.name: storage_none_volume_deletion
options.description: Indicates if all non-RAID volumes are automatically deleted prior to creating the new volume.

options.name: storage_subsystem_id
options.description: ID of the Storage Subsystem on which the volume is to be created.

options.name: strip_etag_quotes
options.description: Removes surrounding quotes of etag used in C(If-Match) header of C(PATCH) requests. Only use this option to resolve bad vendor implementation where C(If-Match) only matches the unquoted etag string.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to OOB controller. The default value for this parameter changed from V(10) to V(60) in community.general 9.0.0.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for authenticating to OOB controller.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to V(true) to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with O(ca_path).

options.name: volume_details
options.description: Setting dictionary of volume to be created. If C(CapacityBytes) key is not specified in this dictionary, the size of the volume is determined by the Redfish service. It is possible the size is not the maximum available size.

options.name: volume_ids
options.description: List of IDs of volumes to be deleted.
